constraints: Only supported for rectangles, and (4D projects only) inputs and text areas.
For input and text-area objects, the corner radius only has a visible effect with "none", "solid", or "dotted" border line styles.
The new radius is set only for the current process and is not saved in the form itself.

discriminatedBy.rule: When '*' is passed, object is an object name (Text) identifying the target by name; when '*' is omitted, object must be a direct Variable or Field reference.

overloadMerges.semanticRole: Modifies (for the current process only) the corner radius of the designated form object.
overloadMerges.note: Merged the leading-'*' dual signature into one overload with object as a Text/Variable,Field union discriminated by '*'.
